meta.name: frontend
meta.description: MUST USE for frontend/web UI/UX/visual work: building, styling, redesigning pages/components, React setup, performance audits, visual QA, taste, and polish. Routes four rulesets: design taste router and brand references; perfection for Playwright/Chromium Lighthouse/Core Web Vitals; ui-ux-db palettes/fonts/guidelines; designpowers personas/accessibility/critique/handoff; plus curl-only lazyweb real-app-screen research and the beui.dev interaction catalog. Triggers: frontend, UI, UX, design, redesign, styling, layout, animation, motion, interaction, micro-interaction, make it feel alive, premium, luxury, minimal, brutalist, Awwwards, DESIGN.md, mockup, React, Lighthouse, accessibility, WCAG, Core Web Vitals, looks generic, make it pretty, like X brand, lazyweb, design research.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计优质前端界面，整合品牌与性能标准
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要构建美观且高性能的前端界面
copy.tagline_en: Design high-quality frontend UI with brand and performance standards
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to build beautiful and high-performance frontend UI

howto.what: Claude会把前端工作转为固定流程:先选参考规则、写DESIGN.md设计规范,再实现组件;最后用Playwright真实浏览器做Lighthouse审计、要求各项满分,并给出报告。
howto.when: 当用户提到frontend、UI、design等关键词,或要求做前端搭建、重设计、性能审计时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一个React落地页,设计要像Stripe那样
say.note: 会套用Stripe的品牌参考并生成DESIGN.md

say.text: 跑一下Lighthouse审计,所有指标都要满分
say.note: 会用Playwright真实浏览器测移动端和桌面端

say.text: 这个页面太丑了,帮我重新设计一下
say.note: 会走重设计流程,先做视觉审计再改

howto.what_en: It routes frontend tasks to reference rulesets, enforces a DESIGN.md design contract before coding, and validates the result with real-browser Lighthouse audits.
howto.when_en: Triggers on any frontend/UI/UX/visual request: keywords like frontend, UI, design, or tasks like React setup, Lighthouse audits, redesign, visual QA, etc.

say_en.text: Build me a React landing page styled like Stripe.
say_en.note: Loads Stripe's brand reference and generates DESIGN.md.

say_en.text: Run a Lighthouse audit; all metrics should be 100.
say_en.note: Uses real Playwright Chromium on mobile and desktop.

say_en.text: This page looks bad; please redesign it.
say_en.note: Runs the redesign workflow: audit first, then update.
